title: sentilab-open-proposal/1
description: One proposal, posted as a threaded reply to a challenge root (DESIGN rev 3 section 5.1). Data only: no free text, and no binary, host, grid, timeout, statistic, reference, budget or grant field. proposal_key is the logical key, scoped to the account and manifest. parent is null or one of the account's own earlier geometry hashes. visibility is the explicit publication choice; a private proposal travels sealed (section 3.7). salt makes proposal_sha256 = sha256(JCS(this object)) unguessable: that hash is the content hash in the transport key and the private status handle, a bearer secret. client is optional, private and never rendered. Manifest-dependent rules (open manifest, accepted terms, die count and order, frame, rotations, lattice, layout, the geometry hash) are checked by the validator.
